analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (193,700 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (196,300 KRW / 209,525 KRW / 234,766 KRW): below short/mid-term trends, confirming weak position
· Position vs SMA100/200 (248,158 KRW / 237,822 KRW): below long-term trends, maintaining weak strength
· 52-week position (35.4%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.1 → 38.4): entering oversold territory, downward momentum continues
· MACD histogram trajectory (-450.3665 → -180.5284): improving within negative territory, no confirmation of trend reversal signal yet
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 179,265 KRW): approaching lower band, 28.88% band width indicates potential for increased volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (189,200 KRW): based on 20-day low of 179,200 KRW, key defense line on decline
· Swing resistance (209,000 KRW): SMA20 level, short-term rebound expected on breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): forming a pattern of rising lows, potential for recovery signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.53x): contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI entering oversold and Higher Low pattern forming, but maintaining wait-and-see due to lack of volume
